## Summary

Explain the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the isolated plugin integration test.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation or the changelog where needed.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, private media, generated output, or machine-specific paths.

## Safety review

- [ ] This does not weaken workspace containment, source-media preservation, or approval behavior.
- [ ] This does not introduce shell-string process execution.
